initiatives.name: Strategic Acquisition Programme
initiatives.summary: Bunzl completed 13 acquisitions during 2024 with committed acquisition spend of £883 million, marking a record year. The acquisitions included first geographic expansion into Finland through Pamark Group and the acquisition of Nisbets, a leading catering equipment distributor with strong digital capabilities.

evidence.title: Three-year acquisition commitment of £700m annually
evidence.summary: The Group committed to allocate approximately £700 million per annum primarily to value-accretive acquisitions for each of the three years ending 31 December 2027. Any shortfall will be returned to shareholders through capital returns.
evidence.quote: In August 2024 the Group committed to allocate c.£700 million per annum, primarily to invest in value-accretive acquisitions and, if required, returns of capital, in each of the three years ending 31 December 2027. If at the end of each year, the total committed spend is below £700 million, the Group will return the remainder to shareholders through a capital return in the following year.

evidence.title: Record 13 acquisitions completed in 2024
evidence.summary: Bunzl completed 13 acquisitions during 2024 with committed acquisition spend of £883 million, marking a record year. The acquisitions included first geographic expansion into Finland through Pamark Group and the acquisition of Nisbets, a leading catering equipment distributor with strong digital capabilities.
evidence.quote: Bunzl has had a record year of allocating capital to acquisitions, with 13 announced in 2024. Over the year, acquisitions included our first geographic expansion into Finland and Bunzl's acquisition of Nisbets, a leading, high quality distributor of catering equipment and consumables with a strong own brand portfolio and excellent digital capabilities.

initiatives.name: Acquisition Pipeline Strategy
initiatives.summary: Bunzl completed eight acquisitions in 2025 across seven countries and four sectors with committed spend of £132 million and combined annualised revenue of £92 million. Notable acquisitions include entry into Chilean healthcare market and establishment in Slovakia.

evidence.title: Continued Acquisition Strategy with £132M Committed Spend
evidence.summary: Bunzl maintained its active acquisition pipeline as a key component of growth strategy, having completed 237 acquisitions since 2004. The company committed £132 million to acquisitions during 2025, including specific deals like Hospitalia in Chile and Damito in Slovakia.
evidence.quote: During 2025, the Group's committed acquisition spend was £132 million and the pipeline remains active.

evidence.title: Eight Acquisitions Across Seven Countries
evidence.summary: Bunzl completed eight acquisitions in 2025 across seven countries and four sectors with committed spend of £132 million and combined annualised revenue of £92 million. Notable acquisitions include entry into Chilean healthcare market and establishment in Slovakia.
evidence.quote: We completed eight acquisitions over the year, across seven countries and four core sectors, each of which supports Bunzl's strategic development. In 2025, acquisitions enabled us to enter the Chilean healthcare market and establish a physical footprint in Slovakia. After a strong year in 2024, 2025 was a slower year for total spend, with a committed spend of £132 million, reflective of the impact of the macroeconomic environment.

initiatives.name: Science-Based Net Zero Transition Plan
initiatives.summary: Bunzl's net zero transition plan was formally approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) in 2024. The company committed to net zero emissions by 2050 with interim targets including 80% of suppliers by emissions having science-based targets by 2027.

evidence.title: Science-based climate targets approved by SBTi
evidence.summary: Bunzl's net zero transition plan was formally approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) in 2024. The company committed to net zero emissions by 2050 with interim targets including 80% of suppliers by emissions having science-based targets by 2027.
evidence.quote: In 2023, we followed the SBTi's Net Zero Standard to develop our transition plan and are pleased that this was formally approved by the SBTi this year.

evidence.title: Carbon Reduction Targets by 2030
evidence.summary: Bunzl has set science-based carbon reduction targets including 27.5% reduction in absolute scope 1 and 2 emissions and 50% reduction in emission intensity by 2030 versus 2019 baseline. Currently achieved 18% and 26% reduction respectively.
evidence.quote: 2030 target (vs 2019) Total scope 1 and scope 2 emissions market-based (tonnes of CO2e) 27.5% Emission intensity market-based (tonnes of CO2e/£m revenue) 50%

evidence.summary: Bunzl has approved science-based targets including 50% carbon efficiency improvement by 2030, 80% of suppliers to have science-based targets by 2027, and 90% absolute emissions reduction by 2050. evidence.quote: Our carbon reduction targets can be found on pages 51 of our Annual Report with our performance shown on pages 51 to 52. initiatives.name: North America Distribution Operating Model Restructuring
initiatives.summary: Bunzl North America Distribution moved from a branch-based operations model with 40+ general managers to a centralized sales and operations model separating supply chain from sales activities. This change caused execution challenges and loss of local agility, requiring subsequent corrective actions including leadership changes and re-empowerment of local teams.

evidence.title: North America Distribution Operating Model Changes
evidence.summary: Execution challenges related to a change in the operating model of Bunzl's largest operating company, Bunzl North America Distribution, resulted in performance issues. The business focused on improvement actions and saw business wins in the second half of 2025.
evidence.quote: Execution challenges related to a change in the operating model of our largest operating company, Bunzl North America Distribution, alongside a challenging macroeconomic environment resulted in wallet share loss within its foodservice customer base. The business has been focused on actions to improve performance and has seen business wins in the second half of 2025.

evidence.title: North America Distribution Operating Model Restructuring
evidence.summary: Bunzl North America Distribution moved from a branch-based operations model with 40+ general managers to a centralized sales and operations model separating supply chain from sales activities. This change caused execution challenges and loss of local agility, requiring subsequent corrective actions including leadership changes and re-empowerment of local teams.
evidence.quote: In order to strengthen Distribution's platform for longer-term growth, we decided to move from a branch-based operations model with more than 40 general managers overseeing the entirety of their own operations locally, to a sales and operations model, which separates supply chain from sales activities. This change was made to enhance our service and focus on sales development, and was largely implemented by the start of 2024.
